title: Integrity checking of NAS signalling messages in the UE

entities.name: UE 5GMM entity
entities.description: The 5G Mobility Management entity in the UE responsible for processing NAS signaling messages.

entities.name: Secure exchange of NAS messages established
entities.description: Condition where the network has established secure exchange of 5GS NAS messages for the NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: IDENTITY REQUEST (SUCI)
entities.description: IDENTITY REQUEST message when the requested identification parameter is SUCI.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REJECT (except cause #76 or #78)
entities.description: REGISTRATION REJECT message when the 5GMM cause is not #76 or #78.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT (non switch off)
entities.description: DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message for non switch off scenarios.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT (except cause #76 or #78)
entities.description: SERVICE REJECT message when the 5GMM cause is not #76 or #78.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: SECURITY MODE COMMAND message used for security activation.

entities.name: Integrity check failed
entities.description: Condition where a NAS signalling message has not successfully passed integrity checking.

entities.name: Message discard
entities.description: Behavior where the NAS in the UE discards a message that fails integrity check or is not integrity protected when secure exchange is established.

relations.description: UE 5GMM entity requires secure exchange to be established before processing most NAS signalling messages.
IDENTITY REQUEST (SUCI) can be accepted without integrity protection.
REGISTRATION REJECT (except cause #76 or #78) can be accepted without integrity protection.
DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT (non switch off) can be accepted without integrity protection.
SERVICE REJECT (except cause #76 or #78) can be accepted without integrity protection.
When secure exchange is established, integrity check failure guards message processing.
Integrity check failure establishes message discard behavior.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND with integrity check failure triggers special processing as specified in subclause 5.4.2.5.
